messages:
maria: Scheduling the user_email_flags migration for Thu 23:30 UTC. Need a short quiesce and explicit rollback plan.

sam-db: Plan -> ghost-table + backfill + atomic swap behind feature flag. Backfill sharded, throttled to avoid IO spike. Estimated runtime ~45m but we'll gate with holdpoint at swap.

jon: Quick perf question: is the backfill read-heavy? Could it impact p99?

sam-db: Mostly read heavy. 1.2M rows; we expect ~15 rows/s per worker. We'll run 6 workers across shards and add sleep between batches.

deploybot: Scheduled: migration.user_email_flags by sam-db at 2024-11-14T23:30Z. React with :white_check_mark: to acknowledge. canary=1/3, parallel=3.

ops: Please pin api/web to v2.14.1 for the 1h change window. If we need to rollback, revert code pins first.

emily: I will push image pins at T-20m. Also drafting release note mentioning flag email_flags_v2.

sam-db: Rollback criteria (proposed):
- any shard error rate >2% over 5m
- sustained DB lock wait >250ms for 2m
- replica lag >30s on 3+ replicas
If triggered: pause backfill, revert pins, escalate.

maria: Add manual approval at swap. We'll only swap after smoke-checks pass.

jon: Can deploybot add a step hold? like:
```
deploybot hold 1729999999 swap
```

deploybot: Holdpoint created at step=swap. Canary will pause and notify channel.

sam-db: Backfill args:
--shards=8 --concurrency=3 --batch=500 --throttle-ms=150
Should keep io < safe threshold.

ops: I'll apply ingress traffic dampen (50%->25%) around swap for 10m. Helm patch ready.

sre-bot: Runbook link posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-backfill-ops

emily: Release note internal draft: "Email flags column migration complete; feature flag email_flags_v2 available. No user-facing changes expected." External note T+1d.

maria: Who owns rollback?

sam-db: DB rollback owner: me (pause + fix). Ops: revert pins. Maria: comms.

jon: If replica lag spikes, do we abort swap or just backfill?

sre-bot: Abort swap, pause backfill, page DB oncall.

maria: T-30m will post final checklist. React on T-5.

emily: Acked.

deploybot: migration.user_email_flags started (canary 1/3). Logs: /deploys/1729999999/logs

sam-db: Canary shard OK. throughput ~16 r/s, no locks.

maria: Running smoke checks now. Posting results shortly.

maria: Smoke checks OK (send/read/p99 stable). Reached swap holdpoint.

deploybot: swap reached - HOLD in place awaiting manual approve.

ops: Ingress dampen active. Traffic ~24%.

jon: Observability: p99 steady, replication lag 3s. Proceed if no objections.

maria: Approving swap.

deploybot: swap executed. migration.user_email_flags canary -> rolling shards.

sam-db: Rolling remaining shards 1..7 with rate cap. Monitoring.

emily: Posted internal release note. External note will follow.

maria: We'll check at +1h and close thread. Thanks all. :tada:
